name: dnd-app-v2
description: Locally-hosted real-time D&D virtual tabletop with separate DM and player views, exposed remotely via Cloudflare Tunnel.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e -w client && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts

comments.overrides: Require shell-quote >=1.11.0 to address GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv in the development dependency tree.
